description: This C# source file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization components, specifically testing low-level Reader and Writer implementations using various buffer types such as Stream, MemoryStream, byte arrays, and segment-based buffers. It verifies binary encoding, variable-length integer encoding, buffer management, and stream manipulation functionalities. The file defines multiple test classes each targeting different buffer abstractions and a base class that encapsulates common testing logic.
